title: Deployer does not transfer ownership of `CapAutomator` to admin
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The function `DeployCapAutomator.run` deploys an instance of `CapAutomator`, assigning `msg.sender` (the `deployer`) as the initial owner.
